title: Something Soft is What You Need
description: Inspired by my poem from the poetry collection Dreamy Softness, this piece captures a raw, emotional landscape where movement becomes a sanctuary. It speaks to that inner craving for vulnerability - the realization that 'you need something soft, you need something gentle.' Through swift, expressive brushstrokes and translucent, glazed layers, the dynamic figure of the dancer embodies both a heavy fall and a graceful escape. Between the vibrant friction of pinks and greens, the canvas becomes a refuge, a space to shake off the world and dance through the swelling emotions of the night.
